name: Shoujo no Kami no Ryuushi
source:
Those of the Dark Matter lived by swallowing others who did not accept them.

In the midst of all this, Nemophila---the princess of the Dark Matter---fell in love with Sho, the sole survivor of a planet that she had destroyed for fun, and whom she'd spared as a joke.

This is the story of how dark matter, which is "invisible" to everyone, came to acquire "mass".

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/34170026]official website[/url]]
translation:
暗物质一族，靠吞噬那些不肯接纳他们的存在而生。

其中，暗物质的公主内莫菲拉，仅仅为了取乐便毁灭了一颗星球，又出于一时兴起放过了唯一的幸存者猩。然而，她却爱上了这个少年。

这是任何人都“看不见”的暗物质，逐渐获得“质量”的故事。

[译自[url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/34170026]官方网站[/url]]
